source_caption:
7 years ago today  Once Upon a Time in Hollywood was released. 

The sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, officially titled The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, will premiere globally in IMAX theaters on November 25, 2026, before starting to stream on Netflix on December 23, 2026.

Set in 1977, eight years after the 1969 events of the original film the story follows Cliff Booth working as a Hollywood studio fixer. It is written by Quentin Tarantino and directed by David Fincher.The Cast: Brad Pitt returns as Cliff Booth, starring alongside Timothy Olyphant, Elizabeth Debicki, and Scott Caan.

source_details.synopsis: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is a 2019 comedy-drama film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, who produced it with David Heyman and Shannon McIntosh. Produced by Columbia Pictures in association with Bona Film Group, Heyday Films, and Visiona Romantica, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, it is a co-production between the United States, United Kingdom, and China. It features an ensemble cast led by Leonardo DiCaprio as Rick Dalton, an aging Western hero; Brad Pitt as his stunt double Cliff Booth; and Margot Robbie as actress Sharon Tate, wife of Roman Polanski.
